Then apply the coupon code SAVE15, prepare checkout using credit_card, and place the order for user_id user_1234. After the order is submitted, create an order confirmation receipt that includes the order ID and email it to me. Finally, send me an in-app notification letting me know the order was processed and to check my email for the receipt.
